prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1137; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can reference the claim file.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving through the intersection on a green light, heading east on the main road in Pasadena, Texas.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?
A: Not really. It came from the cross street on my right side. I braked, but there wasn't time to avoid it.

Q: How fast do you estimate you were traveling?
A: Maybe thirty miles an hour, close to the speed limit.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, and the airbags did not deploy, but the belt locked up hard across my chest.

Q: Did you get checked out after the accident?
A: I went to the emergency room that evening. They said I had a neck strain and gave me a cervical collar and some medication.

Q: Are you experiencing symptoms now?
A: Yes. My neck is stiff, I get headaches when I turn my head, and my shoulders ache by the end of the day.

Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?
A: I've been out for a few days and my doctor has me on light duty for now.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was not at fault. The other driver ran the red light, and I want that noted.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
